question: Where was the National Conference on ‘Opportunities of Defence Manufacturing in the Country’ held in India on October 7, 2025?
solution: The correct answer is __**New Delhi**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • The National Conference on **‘Opportunities of Defence Manufacturing in the Country’** was organized in **New Delhi** on **October 7, 2025**. • The primary objective of the conference was to bring together policy makers, industry leaders, and **Defence Public Sector Undertakings (DPSUs)** to discuss the roadmap for achieving self-reliance in the defence sector. • The event highlighted the importance of the **Aatmanirbhar Bharat** initiative, aiming to reduce dependency on imports and establish India as a global **defence manufacturing hub**. • During the conference, discussions were held regarding the enhancement of **private sector participation** and the role of **MSMEs** in the defence supply chain. ***Hence, the correct answer is New Delhi.***
